title: Simple Blog Webpage with Image Upload
description: A minimalistic blog webpage that allows users to create posts with a title, description, and upload images. Designed for simplicity and ease of use without additional functionalities.

features.name: Create Blog Post
features.description: Allows users to create a blog post by entering a title and description.

features.name: Upload Images
features.description: Enables users to upload images to accompany their blog posts.

target_users: General users who want a simple platform to create blog posts with images.
data_requirements: Store blog post data including title, description, and associated images.
